CampaignSave.title: CampaignSave
CampaignSave.description: Stores a player's Jujutsu Kaisen RPG campaign progress synced automatically to the cloud.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the campaign owner.

title.description: Campaign title (character name and current arc).

characterGrade.description: Current Jujutsu grade of the character.

arc.description: Current narrative arc and chronological date.

turnCount.description: Total number of turns played in this campaign.

campaignPayload.description: Serialized full campaign state snapshot (character sheet, turns, world state, memory, custom codex).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the campaign was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the campaign was last auto-saved.

/campaigns/{campaignId}.description: Cloud-synced Jujutsu Kaisen VTT RPG campaign saves owned by individual authenticated users.
